hypothesis: A synthetic-pretrained tabular in-context regressor may provide a different inductive prior than task-trained MLP/TabM or label retrieval.
novelty: Prior index/source review found no TabICL/TabPFN implementation; not the learned small retrieval pilot, not a rerun of failed raw KNN.
facts: Official current regression checkpoint is tabicl-regressor-v2-20260212.ckpt; upstream supports explicitly local model_path and disabling automatic download.
Regressor source uses train-only StandardScaler for y and a separate fit-time ensemble preprocessor; exact categorical, test batching and cache semantics still require source review.
Required missing local dependencies include scikit-learn, einops and huggingface-hub; do not mutate the established environment while existing pilots depend on it.
possible_bounded_test: Reuse fixed input-driven alias-purged retrieval train/query population and raw37-feature frames, with per-airport training contexts; independently freeze package/checkpoint/configuration and all prediction outputs before any target scoring. Need a defensible comparison and separate Jan/Jul current-parent gate before a candidate.
